description.value:
Cost 1 charge of Ghost-Static

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 spirit or ghost-machine

Check Crafting against the target's Will DC

You ground the spirit through your Rig and give its static somewhere quieter to go. Attempt a Crafting check against the target's Will DC. Critical Success The target is pacified toward you and your allies for 10 minutes, or until any of you harms it. Success The target is pacified for 1 round. Failure No effect. Critical Failure The target focuses on you, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty to further Ghost Anchor attempts against it for the rest of the encounter.
